mapper.select: SELECT m.no, m.member_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.email, m.phone, m.birth_date, m.gender, m.postcode, m.address, m.detail_address, m.role, m.profile_image, m.last_login_date, m.regdate, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM social_account sa WHERE sa.member_no = m.no ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS social_login_yn, ( SELECT LISTAGG(UPPER(sa.provider), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sa.provider) FROM social_account sa WHERE sa.member_no = m.no ) AS social_providers FROM member m WHERE m.no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET email = #{profile.email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, phone = #{profile.phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, birth_date = #{profile.birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, gender = #{profile.gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, postcode = #{profile.postcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address = #{profile.address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, detail_address = #{profile.detailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE writer_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AS board_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE writer_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND category = 'QUESTION' AND answer_status = 'WAITING') AS waiting_question_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room WHERE user_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AS chat_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room WHERE user_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND status = 'OPEN') AS open_chat_count FROM dual
SELECT no, category, answer_status, title, created_date FROM board WHERE writer_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY created_date DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT room_no, category, status, last_message, last_message_date, created_date FROM chat_room WHERE user_no = #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, last_message_date DESC NULLS LAST, created_date DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
